Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged "SELL" positions and monitoring broader market health given your tech concentration and margin use.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL (down -34.93%) and SPAL (down -34.04%) given their "SELL" status, leveraged nature, and significant drawdowns.
